prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1299; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the individual injured in the rear-end collision described in the enclosed materials. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or electronic means. Should your insured or any representative of your company wish to speak with our client, we ask that you first obtain our written consent.

We request that you confirm in writing the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to your insured for the date of loss, along with any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please also provide the declarations page for the policy in force at the time of the accident.

Please ensure that all evidence relating to this incident is preserved. This includes vehicle photographs, repair estimates, the vehicle itself and any parts removed from it, dash camera or telematics data, recorded statements, claim notes, adjuster reports, and any communications with other parties. Kindly acknowledge receipt of this letter and confirm your preservation steps within ten business days.
